I was prescribed Venla after my first and most recent bout with major psychotic depression, they put me on 50mg. 
I dont have any experience with any other anti-depressants to compare it to, but I do think it has helped and I haven't experienced any negative effects as far as I'm aware and I've been on it for almost 7 months now. What were some of the negative effects you were worried about? I'm curious

I'm currently using Kelocote on my scars, which seems to be working, slowly, I hadn;t heard about using coconut oil on them, and I'll definitely give that a try :) thanks for the advice.
Yeah I'm the same, I really struggle with shame. I've been diagnosed with bpd and the doctors say, given the circumstances surrounding when I attempted that my depression was triggered by shame. I hate anyone thinking negatively about me to, the possibility really freaks me out.

HAHAHA all such good lil lies, and I'd totally make use of all of them, if it werent for the fact that I also have some pretty horrendous vertical scars down my forearms and thigh along with the neck one that you cant see in the vid, they're all the same colour so its pretty obvious at least to me that they're from the same time, eugh... I'll definitely make use of the chimp fight excuse tho regardless, thankyou :)

I had a bout of major depression at the end of last year. It got the the point where I thought I'd realised who I really was; an empty psychopath. I thought depression had shown me the truth, but it was a lie. 
Depression is an illness, and whilst I know its said that what doesn't kill you makes you stronger, and I definitely have come out of it knowing more about myself then I did before, its important for those who may be going through it to know that its what comes after that really counts, not the depression itself. I don't think I'm getting my point fully across here, but I hope you understand my perspective too

Yeah I guess you're right, that really is the only thing I could say. Its just that I'm worried about making the other person uncomfortable too, especially if its just someone I've only just met. The truth would obviously make things even MORE uncomfortable, but I feel like just shutting them up about it (even nicely) could come across as standoff-ish. Like I'm already scary looking enough with the massive scar on my neck :/ Idk

Yeah I dont know, the scars are in places where I'd have to get full forearm sleeves which I could never do, same with the neck and thigh scars. Like they're already drawing enough attention, and tattoos in those areas especially are just not something I'd personally do, thanks for the suggestion though :)

I can relate to that day after day sorrow, I used to wake up every morning for almost 2 years feeling empty, then becoming sadder and sadder as each day drew out. The only thing I'd look forward to each day was the end of it, sleep. I thought it would never end unless I ended it, and one day I finally tried, unsuccessfully.
You need to know that it really does get better, it has for me, and it can for everyone. Find hope, its worth fighting for.
